caption:
Big boxes on the bottom

The big box goes on the bottom. Three sizes, one tower, and it stays up.

Stacking by size is the cheapest kind of order, and it works with boxes, books, bowls and everything in a cupboard.

For whoever stacks the big one on the bottom.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A table with three squares scattered on it: a big orange one at the middle, a medium blue one and a small yellow one at the right. A ink-black block figure with wide white eyes walks in from the left and leans. The blue square slides over onto the orange one, then the yellow square slides on top of the blue one, making a steady tower. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse.
